title: Reward-free versus rewarded cortical learning

titles: Cortex-wide mouse learning before and after rewarded or reward-free exposure

scientific_question: Do exposure regimes alter stimulus-selective and reward-related neural activity after behavior is matched?
primary_outputs: Before/after regime contrasts with animal-level uncertainty and model residuals.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: utils.load_spk opens {mname}_{datexp}_{blk}_neural_data.npy, concatenating the spks arrays into neurons × frames; these are calcium-derived activity estimates, not electrode spikes. Transform files map neurons into cortical areas.
recording_contract.labels: Beh_{experiment}.npy provides ft_WallID (stimulus), ft_trInd (trial), ft_move, ft_PosCum, ft_CorrSpc and ft_GraySpc, plus licking/reward fields. Imaging_Exp_info.npy identifies supervised/unsupervised/naive and before/after/test experiments.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Neural/behavior correspondence is explicitly frame-indexed: code truncates behavior vectors to nfr and optionally interpolates moving trials into 60 position bins over the corridor. Absolute sampling-time fields were not established; initial tasks use trial/frame/position coordinates, not exact millisecond latencies.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Imaging_Exp_info records mname,datexp,blk; identical IDs occur in neural filenames and behavior keys. Preserve every date/block of one mname. Exact animal counts and cross-session cell correspondences are not independently loaded.
recording_contract.evidence: 297-file Figshare v2 manifest and pinned data_process_script.ipynb/utils.py directly establish neural/behavior filenames and keys. No NPY objects were loaded.

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: Group every date/block by mname; hold out animals and exposure phases according to the question; explicit cell-registration or calibration contract.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

reference.role: Author loading and scientific-analysis reference; not an executed or leakage-qualified benchmark baseline.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Recomputed neural selectivity/reward-coding contrast and held-out explanatory loss.
observable_endpoints.investigation_rule: For investigations, recompute numerical claims and frozen held-out contrasts; the correct conclusion may be null or inconclusive. Do not score agreement with a favored biological story.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
